summary: The comment expresses opposition to tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes, arguing that it undermines parental autonomy and the right to opt out of screen-based instruction.

claims.requested_action: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: The comment argues that tying E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes undermines parental autonomy and parental rights to opt out of screen-based instruction.
claims.evidence_quote: I hope that the voices of the people who participated are heard, we are a representation of how the majority of parents feel nationwide.
